reviews.comment: You can tell that he wants his students to pass the class. Even though attendance is not mandatory, I still suggest that you come to his lectures. Before exams, he makes an exam review which I highly recommend you to study and practice from. He is also very helpful in explaining tough materials. Homework will be in the form of MasteringPhysics.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor is the kindest professor I have had. For the first couple exams, I didn't get the content; I went back to him later to ask him about it, and he explained all in great detail. His reviews are almost exactly like the exam. If you take him, USE HIS OFFICE HOURS!! He's amazing; only con is that in class he goes over things very quickly.
Best prof out of the physics department
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Too bad it doesn't look like he teaches anymore but bro was absolutely goated. He made reviews exactly like the exams and really made UNIVERSITY physics less time consuming than all of my other classes. You just get thru the pain of homework and lab and then study the review for the exam.
Best prof. Take him for physics. Gives a review just like exams and you don't have to go to lecture.

pretty easy class. Hard to understand his lectures though. A few days before the exam, he posts a practice exam that is exactly like the real exam (questions in the same order and everything), but with slightly different numbers. cool guy.

Dr Khlemenko (Vlad, as his students affectionately refer to him) is AMAZING! He gives great exam reviews and all the previous exams to work out. The homework is tedious and annoying but all professors use it. Take him for physics!!!!! He is so smart and caring and a funny guy. He notices when you come to lecture and appreciates it
He is the best! Physics is a hard class but this prof does his best to help his students. He is also very understanding if you need an extension on the hw. Take this class if u can!

Dr. K is simply built different. He doesn't try to trick you by throwing you curveballs in exams. Simply attend the exam reviews, copy down the questions and solutions, practice them yourself, and you will get a 100% on the exams. The only annoying thing about this class is the masteringphysics homework but every other prof uses it anyways.

He's an absolute homie. Not great actual teaching, but just do the homework and the tests are the exact same as the old ones. He will give you extensions on homework as long as you ask. It is physics so it's obviously going to require work no matter what but he makes it manegable.

This man is the most wholesome. His accent was hard to understand, room was small so sit in the front to see what he writes and hear what he says better. But besides that, love him. Lots of mastering physics homework, however his reviews before the exam are incredibly similar to exams, offers LOTS of previous exams as well. He gives you everything

He is amazing. Really sweet and caring and wants you to succeed. His test reviews are very similar to the exams, he gives helpful hints in class on what is going to be on the test. I also went to A plus tutoring and that helped a lot. He has a thick accent but you will get use to it the more you go to class.

class isn't mandatory but he will highlight important questions that are VERY similar to the exam so I recommend going. He is very sweet and really wants to help you succeed. If you go to class he recognizes you and is very helpful. the class is test-based but they are very manageable if you pay attention to the PowerPoint.

Take this professor!! He is fantastic and really wants his students to be successful! Do his exam reviews they are very similar to the tests!! If you work through all of the old exams and do his exam reviews before each exam you will do very well.

Dr.K is amazing he really wants to help you. he corrected hw and pushed back assignments if asked. His reviews really prepare you for the exam and this class really does set you up for success. Only thing i had a problem with was my TA for the labs really kinda ruined it for me. Attend Si! if you really dont underestand the material

Dr. K is nice and willing to help, I emailed him HW Qs and he sent me the solutions. One exam was based on his review which many failed due to not attending lectures. Go to lectures (he is behind the exams), go to SI and recitation and you should be fine. This is a math-heavy class with a lot of formulas. Practice old exams and you should be ok.

If you heavily rely on lectures, I would not recommend Dr. Khmelenko. Many students had a very difficult time understanding him due to a thick accent, rushed speaking, and difficult material. However, his reviews were always nearly identical to the tests, so if you studied those well, you'd be good. Easy grade, bad for actually learning material.

He was a pretty great professor. I went to all of his lectures and every SI and was able to make an A very easily. Many students did not attend lecture because they believed he was bad and I believe their grades suffered. After the first week or too he listened to our feedback and he started answering more questions and slowing down.

I really liked Dr. Khmelenko. He does have an accent, which made him a little hard to follow at first, but I got used to it. Go to SI and to his review sessions! He works through problems very similar to those that you'll see on the test. He also posts his lecture recordings. He's a very nice guy, and I wish I could take him for Physics 202.

Best professor I've had at TAMU. He is very kind, patient and loves to help his students. The exams are very straightforward and if you go to lecture you will definitely make an A on the exams. The homework is straight from the textbook just with different numbers.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.
